mysql-aiops 0.1.0 – Initial Preview Release

- Introduces a standalone MySQL/MariaDB DBA toolkit with built-in governance (audit log, policy, undo, risk-tiers).
- Secure password management: stores MySQL account passwords encrypted (Fernet/scrypt), never plaintext.
- Covers 33 read/write DBA operations: health check, slow query & lock RCA, index/table analysis, session/replica management, and more.
- All writes are audited, reversible where possible, and require confirmation and dry-run support.
- No external dependencies; applies only to MySQL 8.x/MariaDB 10.6+ in preview/mock validation mode.
- Not for use with PostgreSQL, non-database, or appliance/cluster/OT targets.
